title: Completion-state persistence per principal in the applied persistence blueprint with an spa-local-storage fallback per Q4
description: The completion state persists per principal in the applied persistence blueprint (server-side-per-principal when a persistence blueprint is applied and the operator picks that store) or per browser in spa-local-storage as the Q4 fallback when no persistence blueprint is applied. spa-session-storage is a third option the operator can pick when a per-session tour is deliberately wanted. A restart-tour control renders on the settings surface (composing on application-account-settings when applied; on any settings-shaped surface as a fallback) and clears the completion state so the tour re-opens on the next principal load.
rationale: Per visual round 4 spec (2026-09-06) section 5.5, REQ 4 of the onboarding-tour blueprint. Q4 default (spa-local-storage fallback) ratified per spec section 10.
